title: FMLA and related leave provisions - 2019 handbook extract
summary: Historical 2019 handbook extract containing funeral pay, military leave, FMLA rules and the beginning of the non-solicitation policy. The 2025 complete handbook is the later supplied version in the same handbook lineage and supersedes these provisions.

claims.claim: The 2019 extract provides up to three paid funeral-leave days for full-time employees for the listed family relationships, requires documentation, and requires notice to the supervisor no later than the first day of absence.

The 2019 extract describes military leave for Reserve/National Guard annual duty, generally up to ten working days in a calendar year absent special circumstances, with written request to the Executive Director at least 30 days before the proposed start.
The 2019 FMLA section describes up to 12 weeks of unpaid leave in a 12-month period for the listed family/medical reasons and up to 26 weeks in a single 12-month period for military caregiver leave.

evidence.note: Preserved as historical RTEC policy language, not independently verified legal guidance.

claims.claim: The 2019 section requires accrued paid leave to be applied to FMLA, states FMLA runs concurrently with workers' compensation leave, requires a physician statement, and requires the employee to pay their share of health/vision/dental premiums while on FMLA.

The 2019 section states health coverage continues during FMLA with the employee paying their share, describes possible recovery of employer-paid health benefits if the employee does not return, and describes return to the same/comparable position for non-key employees subject to the stated conditions.

evidence.page_or_section: printed page 22 - RTEC Employee Policy items 1-3

claims.claim: The 2019 section requires 30 days' notice for foreseeable leave, describes key-employee and eligibility exclusions, requires a fitness-for-duty statement to return, and states employment terminates after 12 weeks if the employee cannot return to the former position.

evidence.page_or_section: printed page 23 - RTEC Employee Policy items 4-10
evidence.note: Preserved verbatim in substance; current legal compliance is not inferred.

claims.claim: The final supplied page begins the non-solicitation/distribution policy, prohibiting unapproved workplace solicitation/distribution during working time or through RTEC email/telephonic systems.

evidence.note: Only the beginning of this section appears in the supplied extract.

trigger: Historical leave event falling under the 2019 handbook period.
steps: Historical reference only: use the 2019 extract when reconstructing how a leave case may have been handled under that handbook version.
deadlines: 30 days' notice for foreseeable FMLA and military leave as stated in the source.
Funeral-leave notice no later than the first day of absence.
exceptions: The source contains the policy's stated key-employee and eligibility exclusions.
controls: Physician support and fitness-for-duty documentation under the historical policy.

provenance.notes: Superseded by the later complete 2025 handbook in the same policy lineage.
